item.title: Women’s Basketball Sweeps Santa Clara on Senior Night
item.description: Pepperdine Women's Basketball played the Santa Clara University Broncos on Feb. 21 at Firestone Fieldhouse. In the second matchup between the two teams this season, the Waves won in dominant fashion, 80-63, sweeping the Broncos in conference play. The post Women’s Basketball Sweeps Santa Clara on Senior Night appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Opinion: Performing Arts Will Save Us From The Numbing of AI
item.description: Artificial intelligence can now generate music, art and entire videos in seconds. Podcast Producer Ellya Asatryan argues that in an age of endless digital content, live performance offers something AI cannot replicate. The post Opinion: Performing Arts Will Save Us From The Numbing of AI appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Opinion: The Halftime Show Outshines the Game
item.description: The Super Bowl halftime show has evolved from a simple intermission into one of the most anticipated moments of the night. Perspectives Writer Hana Wadlow explores how performances by Rihanna, Kendrick Lamar and Bad Bunny reshaped expectations for what halftime can be. The post Opinion: The Halftime Show Outshines the Game appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: SGA Passes Nature’s Edge Snack Resolution
item.description: SGA passed a new resolution sending a list of new snacks to Nature's Edge and passed a general funds request for the Waves Private Equity Association. item.description: Pepperdine Women’s Tennis enters the spring season with a shared mindset to achieve success. With a mix of returning players and newly added freshmen, the Waves are setting their sights on growth as a team on and off the court. item.title: Men’s Basketball Struggles Offensively in Loss to Seattle
item.description: Pepperdine Men's Basketball battled the Seattle Redhawks on Feb. 25 at Firestone Fieldhouse for the second time this season, falling 87-80. The Waves moves to 8-22 on the season, falling to last place in the West Coast Conference, setting them up for a tough West Coast Conference tournament March 5-10. item.title: ‘From Loss to Light’: Arik Housley Discusses Finding Resilience in Grief at 2026 RISE Summit
item.description: Pepperdine hosted Arik Housley (‘96), father of Pepperdine student Alaina, who was killed in the mass shooting at Borderline Bar & Grill in 2018. Housley spoke at the W. David Baird Distinguished Lecture Series and the annual RISE Summit on Feb 20.
